name: leaf
description: Collaborate through a commentable HTML page in the browser: present plans, findings, and work in progress, then carry the user's anchored feedback back into the session.

interface.shortDescription: Collaborate with your agent in a commentable local page.
interface.longDescription: Present plans, findings, and work in progress as a local HTML page with anchored comments, interactive decisions, and live revisions.
defaultPrompt: Present this work as a Leaf page.
Use Leaf to put this plan on a page.
